targets.doc/summary.md:
# Summary

The statute specifies a retention rule for records of the society. Records are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute [[cite:obs-216f877f109093f7a26fed1358f7faa383672994 "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]].

The statute's retention rule is that records of the society are kept according to the schedule specified within the statute itself [[cite:obs-216f877f109093f7a26fed1358f7faa383672994 "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]].

The statute does not specify the exact duration in this source, only that the retention period is named in the schedule of the statute [[cite:obs-216f877f109093f7a26fed1358f7faa383672994 "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]].
